t-1000.author: dana_eats
t-1000.title: Alder Street Kitchen - Alder District
t-1000.body:
Alder Street Kitchen
1412 NW Alder St, Alder District, Rosewood OR 97210
Hours: Tue-Sun 17:00-22:00, closed Mon
Price: $$$   Rating: 4.5 stars (3 reviews)

Seasonal Pacific Northwest menu, wood-fired oven, a short wine list that changes weekly. Reservations recommended on weekends; the counter is walk-in.

replies.author: dana_eats
replies.body: ***** 5/5. The halibut with charred leek was the best thing I ate this spring. Service paced the meal perfectly. Counter seats let you watch the oven.

replies.author: alice_c
replies.body: ****. 4/5. Excellent food, tight room - if you are seated by the door you will feel every arrival. Ask for the back.

replies.author: tomas_k
replies.body: ***** 5/5. Went for an anniversary. They remembered from the booking note and brought a small dessert. Little things.

t-1001.author: priya_r
t-1001.title: Saffron & Sage - Belmont
t-1001.body:
Saffron & Sage
3320 SE Belmont St, Belmont, Rosewood OR 97210
Hours: Daily 11:30-21:30
Price: $$   Rating: 4.4 stars (3 reviews)

Southern Indian, mostly vegetarian, dosas to order. Lunch thali is the move. Cash and cards, no reservations.

replies.author: priya_r
replies.body: ***** 5/5. Finally a place where the vegetarian menu is the menu. Masala dosa is crisp edge to edge; the sambar has real tamarind sourness.

replies.author: bob_m
replies.body: ****. 4/5. Thali is enormous for the price. Chai is sweet by default, ask for less sugar.

replies.author: the_ostrowskis
replies.body: ****. 4/5. Kids demolished the plain dosas. Busy at 12:30 on weekdays; come at noon.

t-1002.author: marcus_pdx
t-1002.title: Fen & Fog Ramen - Hawthorne
t-1002.body:
Fen & Fog Ramen
2041 SE Hawthorne Blvd, Hawthorne, Rosewood OR 97210
Hours: Wed-Mon 12:00-21:00
Price: $$   Rating: 4.2 stars (3 reviews)

Tonkotsu and a shoyu that is arguably better. Twelve seats, expect a queue. Bike rack out front.

replies.author: marcus_pdx
replies.body: ****. 4/5. Shoyu over tonkotsu here, and I say that as a tonkotsu person. Noodles have proper chew. Queue moves fast.

replies.author: sofia.l
replies.body: ****. 4/5. Broth is rich without being heavy. The soft egg was perfect. Would like a second veg option.

replies.author: hank_b
replies.body: ***.. 3/5. Good soup. Twenty-five minutes standing outside in the rain for good soup is a personal choice.

t-1003.author: the_ostrowskis
t-1003.title: Big Pine Pizza - St. Johns
t-1003.body:
Big Pine Pizza
8720 N Lombard St, St. Johns, Rosewood OR 97210
Hours: Daily 11:00-22:00
Price: $   Rating: 4.0 stars (2 reviews)

Thin-crust by the slice, whole pies to go, a back room with two pinball machines. Kids eat free on Tuesdays.

replies.author: the_ostrowskis
replies.body: ***** 5/5. Tuesday kids-eat-free is real and the pinball room means the adults get to finish a conversation. Crust could be crisper.

replies.author: carol_n
replies.body: ****. 4/5. Solid weeknight pizza, ready in fifteen when you call ahead. Pepperoni cups nicely.

t-1004.author: sofia.l
t-1004.title: Marisol Taqueria - Foster-Powell
t-1004.body:
Marisol Taqueria
6014 SE Foster Rd, Foster-Powell, Rosewood OR 97210
Hours: Mon-Sat 10:00-20:00, closed Sun
Price: $   Rating: 4.7 stars (4 reviews)

Counter-service taqueria, handmade tortillas, salsa bar with six options. Al pastor from the trompo after 16:00.

replies.author: sofia.l
replies.body: ***** 5/5. The al pastor comes off a real trompo with pineapple on top and it is two dollars fifty. There is nothing to improve.

replies.author: dana_eats
replies.body: ***** 5/5. Handmade tortillas are the difference. Salsa verde is properly hot. Go after four for the pastor.

replies.author: bob_m
replies.body: ****. 4/5. Great tacos, limited seating, the parking lot is chaos. Walk or bike.

replies.author: nguyen_family
replies.body: ***** 5/5. Best value meal in the city. Horchata is house-made.

t-1005.author: alice_c
t-1005.title: Northlight Coffee Roasters - Alder District
t-1005.body:
Northlight Coffee Roasters
1180 NW Kearney St, Alder District, Rosewood OR 97210
Hours: Mon-Fri 06:30-17:00, Sat-Sun 07:30-16:00
Price: $$   Rating: 4.6 stars (3 reviews)

In-house roaster, single-origin pour-overs, a few pastries from the bakery next door. Plenty of outlets, decent wifi, no laptops at the window bar after 11.

replies.author: alice_c
replies.body: ***** 5/5. The Ethiopian pour-over changed my mind about light roasts. Staff will talk beans with you for as long as you want and no longer.

replies.author: marcus_pdx
replies.body: ****. 4/5. Excellent espresso, good work spot before ten. The no-laptop window rule is fair and enforced.

replies.author: tomas_k
replies.body: ***** 5/5. Consistent. I have had maybe two hundred flat whites here and one was bad.

t-1006.author: sofia.l
t-1006.title: Rook & Kettle Tea House - Belmont
t-1006.body:
Rook & Kettle Tea House
3411 SE Belmont St, Belmont, Rosewood OR 97210
Hours: Daily 09:00-19:00
Price: $$   Rating: 4.3 stars (2 reviews)

Loose-leaf tea, gongfu service by the pot, quiet by design. No espresso machine and they are not sorry.

replies.author: sofia.l
replies.body: ****. 4/5. Quietest room in the neighbourhood. Oolong flight is the way in if you do not know what you like yet.

replies.author: priya_r
replies.body: ***** 5/5. Masala chai made properly, with whole spices, not syrup. Rare.

t-1007.author: carol_n
t-1007.title: Second Shift Bakery & Espresso - Hawthorne
t-1007.body:
Second Shift Bakery & Espresso
1935 SE Hawthorne Blvd, Hawthorne, Rosewood OR 97210
Hours: Tue-Sun 07:00-14:00, closed Mon
Price: $   Rating: 4.4 stars (2 reviews)

Sourdough, morning buns, cardamom knots. Espresso from Northlight beans. Sells out of buns by ten on weekends.

replies.author: carol_n
replies.body: ***** 5/5. Cardamom knot is worth setting an alarm for. Coffee is good; the pastries are the reason to come.

replies.author: the_ostrowskis
replies.body: ****. 4/5. Weekend line is long but the kids can watch the bakers through the window. Get there before nine.

t-1008.author: hank_b
t-1008.title: Lombard Street Garage - St. Johns
t-1008.body:
Lombard Street Garage
9105 N Lombard St, St. Johns, Rosewood OR 97210
Hours: Mon-Fri 08:00-17:30
Price: $$   Rating: 4.8 stars (3 reviews)

Independent shop, two bays, all makes. They call with the estimate before touching anything and show you the old part.

replies.author: hank_b
replies.body: ***** 5/5. Forty years around garages and this is one of the good ones. Estimate matched the invoice to the dollar. They showed me the worn pads.

replies.author: nguyen_family
replies.body: ***** 5/5. Called with a diagnosis, quoted a price, done same day. Did not upsell the cabin filter.

replies.author: bob_m
replies.body: ****. 4/5. Fair and quick. Waiting room is a bench and a coffee pot, so plan to leave the car.

t-1009.author: marcus_pdx
t-1009.title: Spoke & Sprocket Bike Shop - Foster-Powell
t-1009.body:
Spoke & Sprocket Bike Shop
5820 SE Foster Rd, Foster-Powell, Rosewood OR 97210
Hours: Tue-Sat 10:00-18:00
Price: $$   Rating: 4.5 stars (2 reviews)

Repairs, tune-ups, used bikes, and a free air pump out front. Same-day flat fixes if you drop off before noon.

replies.author: marcus_pdx
replies.body: ***** 5/5. Rebuilt my rear wheel in a day and it has stayed true for a year. Honest about what is worth fixing on an old frame.

replies.author: sofia.l
replies.body: ****. 4/5. Bought a used commuter here; they fitted it properly and threw in a bell. Busy on Saturdays.

t-1010.author: nguyen_family
t-1010.title: Bridgetown Family Dental - Alder District
t-1010.body:
Bridgetown Family Dental
920 NW Lovejoy St, Suite 210, Alder District, Rosewood OR 97210
Hours: Mon-Thu 07:30-17:00, Fri 07:30-13:00
Price: $$$   Rating: 4.7 stars (3 reviews)

General and paediatric dentistry, three hygienists, evening slots on Tuesdays. Takes most insurance; upfront pricing for the rest.

replies.author: nguyen_family
replies.body: ***** 5/5. Three kids, zero tears. The hygienist explained every tool before using it. Front desk sorted the insurance before we sat down.

replies.author: alice_c
replies.body: ***** 5/5. Painless cleaning, no lecture, no invented cavities. Tuesday evening slots are a gift for anyone with a job.

replies.author: bob_m
replies.body: ****. 4/5. Good dentist, expensive without insurance - ask for the cash price before agreeing to X-rays.

t-1011.author: priya_r
t-1011.title: Eastside Physio & Sports Clinic - Hawthorne
t-1011.body:
Eastside Physio & Sports Clinic
2210 SE Hawthorne Blvd, Hawthorne, Rosewood OR 97210
Hours: Mon-Fri 07:00-19:00, Sat 08:00-12:00
Price: $$   Rating: 4.6 stars (2 reviews)

Physiotherapy, running gait analysis, post-surgery rehab. Direct billing for most plans.

replies.author: priya_r
replies.body: ***** 5/5. Fixed a knee two other clinics had given up on. Homework is specific and they check you actually did it.

replies.author: marcus_pdx
replies.body: ****. 4/5. Gait analysis found a shoe problem in ten minutes. Slightly pricey but I stopped hurting.

t-1012.author: bob_m
t-1012.title: Ironwood Climbing Gym - St. Johns
t-1012.body:
Ironwood Climbing Gym
7311 N Burlington Ave, St. Johns, Rosewood OR 97210
Hours: Mon-Fri 06:00-23:00, Sat-Sun 08:00-22:00
Price: $$   Rating: 4.5 stars (3 reviews)

Bouldering and top-rope, resets weekly, a decent weight room. Beginner intro every Saturday morning. Monthly from 79 dollars.

replies.author: bob_m
replies.body: ***** 5/5. Weekly resets keep it interesting and the setters grade honestly. Weight room is a real one, not an afterthought.

replies.author: sofia.l
replies.body: ****. 4/5. Did the Saturday intro with no experience and was climbing by lunch. Evenings are packed; mornings are empty.

replies.author: tomas_k
replies.body: ****. 4/5. Good gym, showers are cold about one visit in five.

t-1013.author: carol_n
t-1013.title: Stillwater Yoga - Belmont
t-1013.body:
Stillwater Yoga
3502 SE Belmont St, Belmont, Rosewood OR 97210
Hours: Daily 06:00-20:30
Price: $$   Rating: 4.4 stars (2 reviews)

Vinyasa, yin, a 06:15 class for the commuters. First week free, then class packs or monthly. Mats provided.

replies.author: carol_n
replies.body: ***** 5/5. The 06:15 class is the only reason I am functional at 09:00 meetings. Teachers adjust without fuss.

replies.author: dana_eats
replies.body: ****. 4/5. Warm, small studio; the yin class on Sundays is a reset. Book the popular slots a day ahead.

t-1014.author: the_ostrowskis
t-1014.title: Columbia Community Pool - St. Johns
t-1014.body:
Columbia Community Pool
7701 N Chautauqua Blvd, St. Johns, Rosewood OR 97210
Hours: Mon-Fri 05:30-21:00, Sat-Sun 08:00-18:00
Price: $   Rating: 4.1 stars (2 reviews)

Public 25-yard pool, lap swim mornings, family swim afternoons, lessons for all ages. Drop-in is five dollars.

replies.author: the_ostrowskis
replies.body: ****. 4/5. Lessons are cheap and the instructors are patient. Family swim on Saturday afternoons is loud, as advertised.

replies.author: hank_b
replies.body: ****. 4/5. Lap lanes at six in the morning, mostly retirees, nobody in a hurry. Locker room could use paint.

t-1015.author: alice_c
t-1015.title: Reliant Plumbing Co. - Foster-Powell
t-1015.body:
Reliant Plumbing Co.
6480 SE Foster Rd, Foster-Powell, Rosewood OR 97210
Hours: Mon-Fri 07:00-18:00, 24h emergency line
Price: $$$   Rating: 4.6 stars (3 reviews)

Licensed and bonded, residential plumbing, water heaters, drain camera. Flat call-out fee credited toward the repair.

replies.author: alice_c
replies.body: ***** 5/5. Sunday night water heater failure, at the door by nine on Monday, done by noon. Price was what they said on the phone.

replies.author: nguyen_family
replies.body: ****. 4/5. Cleared a drain two others could not. Not cheap, but the camera showed exactly what the problem was.

replies.author: tomas_k
replies.body: ***** 5/5. Called before arriving, wore shoe covers, cleaned up. Rare combination.
